identity.name: Polaris Date

case.bezel: fixed steel bezel with dive-style minute track

identity.one_liner: A dive-styled sports watch reviving JLC's 1960s Polaris case language without carrying over the original alarm complication.

narrative.story: Jaeger-LeCoultre revived the Polaris name for a modern sports collection in 2018, drawing on the case shape and inner-ring dial layout of the 1965 Memovox Polaris — a dive/alarm watch built with a patented triple caseback designed to transmit the alarm's sound underwater. The Polaris Date keeps the vintage silhouette and rotating inner chapter ring but drops the alarm mechanism entirely, making it a more straightforward everyday sports watch than its 1960s ancestor.
narrative.collector_notes: The inner rotating ring is friction-set and can develop play over years of use; check that it turns smoothly in both directions and holds its position before buying used.
